title: Test Tagɗo Seniiɗo
intro: Maande neldaama e leñol majjungol. E nder nguurndam maɓɓe welɗam, jeertinaango arii – ina wondi e tagoore teeŋtunde, nde wonata jarribo timmungo e goonɗinal maɓɓe. Jaabawol maɓɓe ina siimta baasal maɓɓe haa abada. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade hol baɗɗo ndee jeertinaango e hol ko wonti saliiɓe ɗum ɓee ?
clues: Ko en leñol ngol nulaaɓe ɓennuɓe ko adii en njiinonoo.
Tagaaɗo mawɗo yalti e dow tulde, maande ummoraade e Joomiraawo men wonande ndee leñol.
Mi wi’i ɓe: “Ɗum ko gelooɗi debbo jeyaaɗi e Alla, accu ɗum ñaama leydi Alla, woto memoɗee ɗum bonannde.”
Kono yim6e 6ee 6uuccii geloocfe am, 6e 6eydii yamiroore Joomiraacfo ma66e.
Miin ko mi nelaaɗo tan ummoraade e Joomiraawo maa, nelaaɗo e goonga—miin ko mi annabi e maccuɗo koolaaɗo.
To bannge tooñooɓe ɓee, Joomiraawo men fiyi ɓe e daande ɓuuɓnde, ɓe ngoni ko e diwde e nder galleeji maɓɓe.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
